MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: An exchangeable food, drink, snack, or special menu item with its coupon requirement.

name.description: Display name of the menu item

description.description: Short appetizing description of the item

couponCost.description: Number of coupons required to redeem this item (1 to 100)

iconKey.description: Fallback icon identifier when no photo is shown

imageUrl.description: Asset URL or empty string for fallback icon card

available.description: Whether the item is currently available for selection

Selection.title: Selection
Selection.description: A user's confirmed coupon exchange selection record.

userName.description: Full name entered by the user

menuItemId.description: ID of the chosen menu item document

menuItemName.description: Snapshot name of the chosen menu item

couponsRequired.description: Number of coupons required at time of selection

submittedByUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID if the submitter was signed in

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator user record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/menu_items/{itemId}.description: Catalog of exchangeable menu items managed by administrators and browsed by users.

/selections/{selectionId}.description: Saved user coupon exchange selections with timestamps and coupon requirements.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Administrator allowlist documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
